newsitem.title: USA: E.W. Scripps' HGTV subscriber base rises.
newsitem.headline: E.W. Scripps' HGTV subscriber base rises.

text.p: Home & Garden Television, a unit of E.W. Scripps Co, said on Monday its subscriber count will more than double to 22 million households by the end of 1996.

"This past year, HGTV has added more than 12 million subscribers", Chief Operating Officer Susan Packard said in a statement. A spokeswoman for HGTV said the network had a subscriber base of 10 million households at the end of 1995.
The network also said it has commitments to launch in an additional six million households, which will bring its total subscriber base to 28 million.
It said it was in the process of launching in New York, Chicago and Los Angeles on Continental Cable Inc, Cox Communications Inc, Comcast Corp and Tele-Communications Inc systems.
